ira (oncall): quick shift scrub — wrapping up my shift, leaving notes for the night. TL;DR: two noisy issues, both mitigated but need follow-ups.

ira (oncall): INCIDENT 1 — embed-ingest autoscaler flapping on dedicated-pool-eu-west; symptoms: 95p token latency +8-12%, sporadic 429s for regen routes. Mitigation: pinned pool to 6 -> forced scale to 8 (temp), applied emergency rate limit on non-critical regen routes, enabled kvcache fallback for hot prefixes. Impact: customer-facing regen degraded briefly but internal fallbacks kept errors <1%. Next steps: rollback forced scale after steady-state, follow up with infra to tune scale cooldowns and smoothing.

ira (oncall): INCIDENT 2 — private-vpc -> logging egress failing intermittently to s3-collector; logs delayed ~10-30m. Mitigation: switched affected hosts to fallback logging endpoint (internal-collector-2), suppressed noisy streaming alerts for 30m. Impact: observability delayed only, inference unaffected. Next steps: file network ticket with packet captures, add degraded-logging note to runbook.

ira (oncall): what I did: forced scale + rate limits, toggled kvcache fallback, added temp alert suppressions, patched small go-healthcheck on dedicated agents. blockers: need infra to confirm autoscaler smoothing patch; need network team for egress root cause.

matt.s: thanks — noted. i'll own embeds check for next shift. please add exact pod names to the ticket if you can. :thumbsup:

ira (oncall): added pod list to the incident ticket: dedicated-pool-eu-01..eu-06, forced-scale target set on eu-07/eu-08 (temp).

sara: can you paste the runbook snippet or link? want to make sure oncall playbook has the fallback logging endpoint and kvcache toggle steps.

ira (oncall): runbook snippet (temp):
```
# toggle kvcache fallback on node
curl -X POST https://infra-admin/api/v1/nodes/eu-05/kvcache/fallback -d '{"enabled":true}'
# check health
curl -sS http://dedicated-pool-eu-07/health | jq .status
```

kevin: nit — autoscaler smoothing should probably be 5m window instead of 1m in prod for this workload. i'll open a small PR to change threshold->0.7 and smoothing->300s. can we defer rollback of forced-scale until that lands? safer to drain.

ira (oncall): agree. leaving forced-scale until PR merges and we observe 15m stable. if latency falls back, i'll start gradual downscale and notify channel.

oncall-bot: [AUTO] Alert: embed-autoscaler-flap resolved (1769992780) — duration 18m.

matt.s: i'll take the handoff — i'll watch latency dashboards for the next 2 hours, ping here before downgrading.

sara: i've started a quick runbook PR: r/1234. adding fallback logging endpoint docs and kvcache toggle steps.

kevin: filed infra PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/487 (autoscaler smoothing). cc @infra-team.

ira (oncall): final notes for next shift: 1) monitor embed 95p and 429s, 2) check autoscaler metric (scale_events and target_util), 3) confirm logging pipeline backfill completes overnight. any blockers DM me. thanks all — leaving the channel in good state.

matt.s: :thumbsup: thanks ira, see you tomorrow.
